newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal leaves key rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it left its key absorption rate, used to drain funds from the money market, and emergency lending rate unchanged.
The absorption rate remains at 6.2 percent and the emergency lending rate at 8.30 percent.

The central bank also said it offered 10 billion escudos of seven-day funds to the money market in a variable rate repurchase pact effective tomorrow at the start of a new accounting period. Bids must be submitted by 1515 GMT.
